title: Candidate sets extend the coordinate prefix
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $k<n$. Suppose an active family consists of subsets of the first $k$ coordinates of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$. For each active set $S$, form the two candidates $S$ and $S\cup\{k+1\}$. Every set in the resulting family is contained in the first $k+1$ coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: every set in the active family is contained in the first $k$ coordinates
